criteria.requirement: Add humanize.calendar.calendar_interval(start,end) and frozen CalendarInterval(sign,years,months,days,seconds,microseconds) with localized text(). Require both date or both datetime endpoints, reject awareness mismatch, convert aware end into start timezone and define wall-clock Gregorian remainder. Find complete months by direct clamp-to-month-end from the earlier endpoint, never iterative month drift; derive complete years/months, retain second/microsecond remainder, normalize reverse interval magnitude with explicit sign and zero. Reuse real translation/precisedelta while keeping naturaldelta approximate duration semantics unchanged; prove leap days, Jan31, partial months, reverse and timezone endpoints.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
